e: Borrowed from Quechua ayllukuna, plural of ayllu.
q: One story has him emerging from a cave about eighteen miles southeast of Cuzco, along with three brothers, four sisters, and ten ayllukuna (clans or extended families).
How can a mute person rule an ayllu of a thousand ayllukuna?
